interventions.what: text screen, BIOS data area and GOAL.EXE memory (DS:7B62, the word at [DS:A978], the score DS:9B3C/9B3D, the commentary ring, the goal store DS:7BD1, the country array at [DS:A917]) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)
savestates written at every read; two loaded (Host+L): the start state, then the captain-screen savestate of this run (vocabulary/interventions.md lists save and load of state as I2)

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process (config sha256 083897d321ed9fe50ca93bbf03ff45765c03c0f2a6e5e5df57aede499ebdc147), game folder recreated from the verified release copy, GOAL run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L loads E006's published main-screen savestate whose sha256 is given (e006-2100-r0005.sav, release E006); polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it (18190236ee20f9eb0573e82714034e41226a92a62efb4c119d8648e06a9a1b67); DOS clock of this session not set
